name: Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
summary: Google's source-grounded AI research notebook, formerly NotebookLM.
description: Gemini Notebook, the new name of NotebookLM since July 2026, is Google's AI research assistant that answers questions grounded only in the sources you upload. It can summarize documents, build mind maps and generate Audio Overviews read aloud. It is free with a Google account (up to 100 notebooks and 50 sources each); Google AI Plus, Pro ($19.99/month) and Ultra plans raise usage and notebook limits.
